rules_satisfied: No production unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable, or unchecked indexing
Lossy 'as' width conversion replaced with u32::try_from
checked_add used for capacity calculation with overflow handling
try_reserve used for bounded Vec allocation with allocation error handling
Payload length checked against max_payload before encoding
residual_risk: Checked_add on 4usize + payload.len() can theoretically overflow only if payload.len() >= usize::MAX - 3, which is practically impossible for valid memory. The Overflow error variant now covers both u32 encoding overflow and capacity overflow.
